items: Salt, pepper, and tabasco to taste

steps.title: Fry the bacon
steps.body: In large Dutch oven, fry **6 slices bacon** until crisp, then remove and crumble.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.body: Brown **1 pound ground beef** and **1 chopped onion**.

steps.title: Add the rest
steps.body: Add and mix together the bacon crumbles, **1 green pepper, chopped**, **1 clove garlic, minced**, **2 Tbsp molasses**, **2 Tbsp brown sugar**, **1 tsp dry mustard**, **⅓ cup vinegar**, **19 oz canned tomatoes**, **1 can kidney beans**, **1 can drained garbanzo beans (chickpeas)**, **1 can pork and beans**, **1 tsp Worcestershire sauce**, and salt, pepper, and tabasco to taste.
